name: Sofia Ramirez
bio:
Sofia Ramirez has dedicated over two decades to the culinary arts, with a passion ignited by her grandmother's traditional Mexican recipes. Her journey into motorsport began unexpectedly when she catered a small local rally event and was captivated by the energy and camaraderie. She believes that a well-fed team is a successful team, and her approach to catering emphasizes not only delicious and nutritious meals but also understanding the specific dietary needs of drivers and mechanics. Sofia's signature touch is incorporating regional Mexican flavors into her menus, offering a taste of home wherever the team travels.

At Iron Lynx, Sofia is known for her meticulous planning and ability to handle the logistical challenges of feeding a large team in diverse locations. She meticulously sources fresh, local ingredients whenever possible, ensuring the highest quality and supporting local communities. Her commitment to sustainability and minimizing food waste sets her apart, and she actively seeks innovative ways to reduce the team's environmental footprint. She is not afraid to get her hands dirty, and is often seen helping the team with small tasks beyond her catering duties. Her unwavering dedication and warm personality make her an indispensable member of the Iron Lynx family.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: A sturdy woman with kind eyes and a warm smile, often seen wearing a practical apron.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with recipes and ingredient notes.
Has a habit of humming quietly while preparing meals.
Insists on starting every day with a cup of strong Mexican coffee.
